command: pre-registration of the P5 stream (50 tasks, two mirrored orders)

hypotheses.S1: structural, fixed before any rollout: within task across the mirrored orders, tasks composed only when late vs only when early (exact sign test); the composed share of the second half vs the first
hypotheses.S2: PRIMARY: composed arrivals (pooled over both orders) non-inferior to the same tasks' own-demo programs at -0.10: one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired difference (two-level bootstrap over arrivals, then episodes)
hypotheses.S3: descriptive: each order's stream success (arrivals as run) vs the all-demo stream (every task its own demo); per-arrival table; bytes

metrics.method: every arrival runs with NO simulator state at test: a pose reader trained only on simulator-rendered scenes of the task (p6_reader.py --synth-only --synth-dir p6_synth_rj) and the in-hand pose predicted from the grasp binding (carry=pred); demo arrivals: phasebind2_rjpred (own demo); composed arrivals: streamc@-
metrics.plan: docs/PLAN_TRANSFER.md P5 / C4 under rules v2: a continual-learning stream whose store is a binding table
metrics.pool: 50 LIBERO-90 tasks the prior fails zero-shot (0/5; ledger zeroshot90): the 21 held-out tasks + 29 found by screening the 49 unscreened tasks; keys by experiments/p5_pool.py (grasp = the goal object's type; place = the whole goal with the object abstracted; a task supplies keys only when its demo's v2 cut matches its goal)
metrics.protocol: orders A = random.Random(0) shuffle, B = A reversed (experiments/p5_stream.py plan); on arrival a task is COMPOSED from the first sources of its keys (no demo), else it requests its ONE demo; keys are never overwritten, so stored programs never change (no forgetting by construction)
metrics.scoring: init states 30-49, 20 episodes per run (m3_final); own-demo runs for all 50 tasks; one run per distinct (task, g, p)
metrics.written_before: any phasebind2_rjpred or streamc rollout (smoke tests excluded)
